title: Turkish Navy Chief Visits Egypt as Air Force Hosts Kuwaiti Counterpart
excerpt: Türkiye's navy commander was in Egypt for Exercise Sea of Friendship-2026, while the air force commander hosts his Kuwaiti counterpart and heads to Pakistan next.
rank_math_title: Turkish commanders: Egypt, Kuwait, Pakistan | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Türkiye's navy chief visited Egypt for Sea of Friendship-2026; the air force chief hosts his Kuwaiti counterpart on 11-14 November and visits Pakistan on 16-19 November.

cover.headline: Turkish commanders engage Egypt, Kuwait and Pakistan
